product.title: Cusco City Tour Four Ruins Half-Day Tour

description.text: In Cusco, this half-day small-group circuit covers Coricancha, then the hillside ruins of Sacsayhuaman, Qenko, Puca Pucara, and Tambomachay. The published cap is about 15 people, with hotel pickup and drop-off in the city center and fees included so the afternoon stays on the four ruins rather than ticket windows. The meeting point is listed on Triunfo. The outing is aimed at visitors who want a guided city introduction before a longer valley or citadel day, without rushing the former Inka capital as a transfer stop only. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Cusco, and the itinerary stays on Coricancha and the four ruins that define this half-day rather than a Sacred Valley highway loop or a Machu Picchu train connection.
